registryAssessment: Local registry/cadastre custody found through the official national Ministry directory, which separately lists Matadi under Kongo-Central. The public-service consultation page describes a formal request to the Conservateur des Titres Immobiliers or Chef de Division du Cadastre; it is not treated as an open geometry service.
